subject.title: Feature: Global session reset on auth switch

question: Should OpenClaw add an admin-scoped global auth refresh/reset capability, and what exact preservation and credential-invalidation semantics should it expose?
rationale: The missing behavior is not a narrow handler repair; it requires a maintainer decision about global credential invalidation, admin authorization, explicit user pins, session identity, and context preservation across channels and runtimes.

options.title: Design global auth refresh
options.body: Add a new Gateway/session capability such as sessions.refreshAuth with all-session scope, auth-only invalidation, explicit admin authorization, and preservation guarantees documented and tested.

options.title: Keep per-session reset
options.body: Keep the current /new, /reset, and sessions.reset model and improve diagnostics/docs for auth switches that need manual per-session recovery.

options.title: Handle only narrower provider bugs
options.body: Defer a global action and fix concrete stale provider/model cache failures through provider-specific doctor or migration flows.

recommendation.title: Design global auth refresh
recommendation.body: Add a new Gateway/session capability such as sessions.refreshAuth with all-session scope, auth-only invalidation, explicit admin authorization, and preservation guarantees documented and tested.
